```{r}
# Install pacman pkg if not installed
if (!requireNamespace("pacman", quietly = TRUE)) {
  install.packages("pacman")

# Loading required packages to the session
pacman::p_load(Seurat, Biobase, ggplot2, patchwork, glmGamPoi,

```

## Quality control of patient CITE-seq experiments

Now, we will load the list of Seurat objects that contain the scRNA-seq dataset
for each patient.

```{r}
load('./patients_CITE_seurat.rda')
```

```{r}
cells_pre <- c()

plots_all <- list()

for (i in 1:length(seurat_list)) {
  # Show metadata slot
  metadata_i <- seurat_list[[i]]@meta.data$patient.id[1]
  print(metadata_i)
  
  # Print dimensions of each dataset
  dim_i <- dim(seurat_list[[i]])
  print(dim_i)
  cells_pre <- c(cells_pre, ncol(seurat_list[[i]]))
  
  # Calculate QC metrics for each dataset
  DefaultAssay(seurat_list[[i]]) <- 'RNA'
  seurat_list[[i]][['mito.per']] <- PercentageFeatureSet(seurat_list[[i]], pattern = '^MT-')
  
  # Plot nCount_RNA, nFeature_RNA & mito.per
  p <- VlnPlot(seurat_list[[i]], features = c('nCount_RNA','nFeature_RNA','mito.per'), 
          group.by = 'patient.id', layer = 'counts')
  print(p)
  
  # Plot correlation between nCount and nFeature
  fs <- FeatureScatter(seurat_list[[i]], feature1 = 'nFeature_RNA', feature2 = 'nCount_RNA', group.by = 'patient.id')
  print(fs)
  
  # Update lists
  plots_all[[length(plots_all) + 1]] <- p
  plots_all[[length(plots_all) + 1]] <- fs
}

final_plot <- wrap_plots(plots_all, ncol = 4)
ggsave(
  "QC_all_samples_single_page.pdf",
  final_plot,
  width = 25,
  height = 30
)
```

Patient samples displayed a higher mitochondrial transcript fraction compared to healthy donors, 
consistent with increased cellular stress and reduced RNA integrity.

```{r}
# Create a list to filter each parameter
filtering_list <- list(
  # nCount_min, nCount_max, mito.per_max
  c(500, 3000, 30), 
  c(500, 3500, 30), 
  c(700, 3000, 25), 
  c(500, 3000, 30),
  c(300, 3000, 30),
  c(500, 3500, 30), 
  c(500, 3000, 30), 
  c(500, 3000, 25), 
  c(750, 3500, 25), 
  c(500, 3200, 20)
)
```

```{r}
cells_post <- c()

# Iterate over the list of seurat objects`
for (i in 1:length(seurat_list)) {
  # Subset the original dataset
  seurat_list[[i]] <- subset(
    seurat_list[[i]],
    subset = nFeature_RNA > filtering_list[[i]][1] & 
      nFeature_RNA < filtering_list[[i]][2] & 
      mito.per < filtering_list[[i]][3])
  
  # Print the dims of the filtered object
  print(seurat_list[[i]]@meta.data$patient.id[1])
  dim_i <- dim(seurat_list[[i]])
  print(dim_i)
  
  # Extract the number of cells
  cells_post <- c(cells_post, ncol(seurat_list[[i]]))
}
```

```{r}
# Amount of cells filtered by QC
print('Number of cells in the raw dataset')
cells_pre
print('Number of cells post-QC')
cells_post
print('Number of cells filtered')
cells_filt <- cells_pre - cells_post
cells_filt

# Percentage of cells filtered
print('Percentage of cells filtered out from the analysis')
paste0(round(100* cells_filt / cells_pre, 2),'%')

```
```{r}
# Save the filtered seurat objects
save(seurat_list, file = './patients_CITE_seu_filt.rda')
```
